scripts.edge:check: node -e "const{globSync}=require('node:fs');const{basename}=require('node:path');const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const files=globSync('tools/edge/**/check*.mjs').filter(f=>{const b=basename(f);return !b.includes('.spec.')&&!b.includes('.test.')}).sort();if(files.length===0){console.error('edge:check: no tools/edge/**/check*.mjs found');process.exit(1)}for(const f of files){const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,[f,...process.argv.slice(1)],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status??1)}" --
scripts.oracle:diff: cd tools/oracle && python3 -m cuotascasa_oracle regenerate --manifest fixtures/manifest.json && git diff --exit-code -- fixtures && test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- fixtures)"
scripts.test:web: if [ -f angular.json ]; then ng test --no-watch; else echo 'test:web: angular.json not created yet (W0-05), skipped'; fi
scripts.typecheck:projects: for p in packages/domain/tsconfig.json packages/schema/tsconfig.json packages/persistence/tsconfig.json packages/sync/tsconfig.json packages/export/tsconfig.json tools/conformance/tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.app.json apps/web/tsconfig.spec.json e2e/tsconfig.json; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then echo "tsc -p $p" && tsc -p "$p" || exit 1; else echo "typecheck: $p not created yet, skipped"; fi; done
